title: SolOS release notes, v1
description: Customer-facing release notes for one device and channel, read by Software Updater. Additive changes (new optional fields, new section types) keep schemaVersion 1; anything that breaks old readers goes under v2/.

device.description: ro.product.device of the devices this file is for; must match the folder name.

releases.description: Newest first. Only builds that are, or were, offered to devices.

version.description: ro.mediatek.version.release without the trailing -<firmware build> number, e.g. 1.0.18-alpha.10.12.

title.description: Optional headline shown above the sections.

type.description: Known types are shown in the order important, new, improvements, fixes. Unknown types are shown after them, under their title.
